admission.justification: Guarded by mcp/tests/test_launch_identity_brief.py and prevents a seat whose harness silently attached a foreign tool server from mutating another task's worktree or memory before noticing the identity mismatch.

applicability: Every role seat launched through brief_prompt across all roles and harnesses.
conditions: IDENTITY_SELF_CHECK_PARAGRAPH appears in the opening brief preamble directly after the AR tools paragraph and before the task-document read instruction.
The preamble directs the seat to verify server_info agentBinding against its handover requestId, role, and task documents while distinguishing host.parent.agentId as the parent.

On any mismatch or missing agents-remember-task server, the preamble directs the seat to do no work, make no writes, send no role_message, and end with one IDENTITY MISMATCH: line of at most 300 characters.
exclusions: This invariant governs the compiled brief text delivered to every seat; runtime enforcement of the seat's response is behavioral and paired with turn-end pass-through (BUG-R51@v1 §4).
statement: Every launched role's opening brief preamble requires a first-action server_info identity self-check against the handover's requestId, role, and task documents (explicitly distinguishing host.parent.agentId as the parent), and directs the seat to do no work, make no write, send no role_message, and end with a single IDENTITY MISMATCH line of at most 300 characters on mismatch or missing server.
title: Opening brief requires first-action server_info identity self-check
